section.content: This utility model discloses a kind of lithium ion battery, described lithium ion battery includes housing, it is positioned at lamellar body and the electrolyte of described housing, wherein, described housing has the sidepiece extended along lengthwise and is at an angle of the bottom of setting with described sidepiece, described lateral ring is around in the periphery of described lamellar body, is provided with insulating trip between described lamellar body and described bottom.This utility model, by arranging insulating trip between lamellar body and the bottom of housing, can effectively prevent the short circuit of battery core one pole, can not stop that again electrolyte infiltrates lamellar body, be effectively isolated the bottom of lamellar body and housing.
本实用新型揭示了种锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池包括壳体，位于所述壳体内的叠片体和电解液，其中，所述壳体具有沿纵长延伸的侧部和与所述侧部成角度设置的底部，所述侧部环绕于所述叠片体的外围，所述叠片体与所述底部之间设有绝缘片。本实用新型通过在叠片体和壳体的底部之间设置绝缘片，既能有效防止电芯单极短路，又能不阻挡电解液浸润叠片体，有效隔离叠片体和壳体的底部。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

This utility model relates to cell art, particularly relates to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technology

At present, battery core technique prevents bottom formed one pole short circuit mode be, by bottom lamellar body with adhesive tape sticking bag Cover, or not adhesive tape of paste, directly using the barrier film beyond pole plate length as sealing coat, isolation pole plate and bottom shell.

But when using in the way of bottom adhesive tape sticking cladding lamellar body, due to the cladding of adhesive tape, electrolyte is difficult to Enter barrier film and pole piece, thus can not effectively infiltrate barrier film and pole piece.And not adhesive tape of paste, use the barrier film beyond pole plate length As sealing coat, with reach to isolate pole plate obtain purpose with bottom shell time, if owing to the reasons such as downthrust cause pole plate to surpass Go out barrier film, thus touch bottom shell, still can form one pole short circuit.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of lithium ion battery, and this lithium ion battery can effectively prevent battery core list Extremely short road, can not stop that again electrolyte infiltrates lamellar body.

For realizing one of above-mentioned utility model purpose, this utility model one embodiment provides a kind of lithium ion battery, institute Stating lithium ion battery and include housing, be positioned at lamellar body and the electrolyte of described housing, wherein, described housing has and prolongs along lengthwise The sidepiece stretched and be at an angle of the bottom of setting with described sidepiece, described lateral ring is around in the periphery of described lamellar body, described lamination It is provided with insulating trip between body and described bottom.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, the material of described insulating trip is insoluble in described electrolysis The plastics of liquid.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, the material of described insulating trip is PP or PE.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, the thickness of described insulating trip is 0.1-0.3mm.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, the bearing of trend phase of described insulating trip and described sidepiece Vertically, the size of described insulating trip matches with the interior size of described sidepiece.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, described lateral ring is around squarely.

As the further improvement of this utility model one embodiment, described lamellar body includes pole piece and the barrier film of stacking.
